questions_and_answers.question_text: Greet someone based on illustration 1 (a person sweating and fanning themselves — it's hot). Write an appropriate Japanese greeting.

answers.answer_text: Atsui desu ne. (暑いですね。) — It's hot, isn't it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Greet someone based on illustration 2 (cloudy sky with rain — nasty weather). Write an appropriate Japanese greeting.

answers.answer_text: Iya na otenki desu ne. (いやなお天気ですね。) — Nasty weather, isn't it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Greet someone based on illustration 3 (a person bundled up and shivering — it's cold). Write an appropriate Japanese greeting.

answers.answer_text: Samui desu ne. (寒いですね。) — It's cold, isn't it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Greet someone based on illustration 4 (bright sun and flowers blooming — beautiful weather). Write an appropriate Japanese greeting.

answers.answer_text: Ii otenki desu ne. (いいお天気ですね。) — It's nice weather, isn't it?
